blocks.t: Perform the following procedure to adjust the display size, centering, and linearity:
1. Set the game to the Self‘est Mode and select the Crosshatch Pattern Display as described in Chapter 2 of the game manual.
visible. Adjust XCENTER (R39) and YCENTER (R55) so that the crosshatch pattern is centered on the screen.

Adjust XSIZE (R34) and YSIZE (R48) so that all four corners of the red outline are off the screen and all four corners of the white outline are completely Adjust XLINEARITY (R38) and YLINEARITY (R50) so that the diagonal lines are straight and the diamondshaped squares are symmetrical. Since the linearity potentiometers change the size of the display, it may be necessary to repeat step 3 to obtain the correct display.
